description: We are WhirAI Space Lab, an emerging technology-focused team passionate about artificial intelligence, software development, innovation, and space exploration. We aim to explore creative solutions to real-world challenges using technology, data, and teamwork. We welcome curious minds, developers, designers, researchers, and problem-solvers who want to learn, collaborate, and build something meaningful together.
summary:
A web application that helps people understand satellite observations of Earth, environmental changes, weather patterns and other planetary data using an accessible AI-powered interface.
This is a concept, not a completed NASA project. We need to select a real challenge and build a working prototype before submitting it.
